_about: End-credits text shared by all four episodes.  Edit wording here, never in an outline.  How and when each section appears on screen is in the end-credits screenplay, end_credits/outline.json.
'from_cast' sections are filled from cast.json at render time, using each character's chosen voice.
'when' marks a section shown only in episodes where that thing is used (euphemia: Professor Euphemia appears; pam: PAM/Blender character animation is used).
'pending': true marks a section still to be filled in; check_outline.py warns until it is.
